implementation: Actual application operation kind is set before outside-lock Board authorization, checked by nativeApplicationBinding and held through its current operation thread; native applicationOperationHeld also verifies actual typed client/service/task and exact closing thread. OOB op kinds cannot masquerade as normal operations.

Native process context accepts either the existing real kernel client or real application operation. Exact process client/task and ring/domain membership remain required. Unbound process observations are limited to actual AttachVm before client open and actual DetachVm after complete normal client teardown.

Native process transitions permit application Prepare/Select/AttachVm only under PrepareTables, and RestoreKernel/DetachVm/RetireDetached only under actual Close. Issuer, idle RBBM/ring state, all process jobs/poison, native table leases and SMMU authority remain mandatory.

Table mutation leases admit app Map or Close with exact process client/task and unchanged fresh hardware idle check. Failed recheck/release retains lease. Normal metadata-gate MMIO exception also requires actual native process submission guard and issuer; no broad user-task MMIO permission.
Shared SMMU/table/VM/submit implementations and public headers remain unchanged from stage2. Existing kernel cases plus real application gating regressions pass.
